description: Simplify Quick Calc in DoctorDashboard.jsx by wrapping the existing BMI and Target Heart Rate calculator widget inside a collapsible HTML <details> element, collapsed by default. The calculator is currently a full-width glass-card column (col-lg-4) that appears alongside the patient directory when no patient is selected. Preserve all calculation logic, state, and UI exactly — only the visibility wrapper changes.
steps: 1. Open frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DoctorDashboard.jsx. Locate the col-lg-4 div containing the Quick Diagnostic Calculator widget (the glass-card with the Calculator icon, 'Quick Calc' heading, and BMI/THR tab contents). This is inside the !selectedPatient branch of the main return.
2. Wrap the inner glass-card div (the one with className starting 'glass-card p-3 d-flex...') with a <details> element. The <details> element should NOT have the 'open' attribute (closed by default).

3. Add a <summary> child as the first child of <details>. Style the summary to match the existing healthcare aesthetic: use the Calculator Lucide icon, text 'Clinical Calculators', monospace font, border-bottom, matching the existing card header style. Example: <summary className='d-flex align-items-center gap-2 p-3 border-bottom border-white-10 font-monospace text-white text-uppercase cursor-pointer' style={{fontSize:'0.95rem',letterSpacing:'0.02em',listStyle:'none'}}><Calculator className='text-theme-accent' size={18}/> Clinical Calculators</summary>
4. The complete inner glass-card div (everything that was already there) remains unchanged inside the <details>, after the <summary>.
5. Do not change any calculator state variables (calcTab, calcWeight, calcHeight, calcAge), calculation formulas, or result display logic.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build in frontend/ exits 0.
The Clinical Calculators section is collapsed (hidden) by default when the Doctor dashboard loads.
Clicking the 'Clinical Calculators' summary expands the calculator widget.
BMI calculation (weight / height^2) still produces correct results.
Target Heart Rate calculation (220 - age, 60-85% zone) still produces correct results.
All existing tab (BMI/THR), range inputs, and result display still work after expand.
findings: Wrapped the existing Quick Diagnostic Calculator glass-card widget in a <details className='glass-card'> element with a <summary> child showing a Calculator icon and 'Clinical Calculators' label. The <details> element has no 'open' attribute so it is collapsed by default. All existing calculator state (calcTab, calcWeight, calcHeight, calcAge), formulas (BMI = weight/height^2, THR = 220-age with 60-85% zone), tab switching, range inputs, and result display logic remain completely unchanged. Build exits 0 (2205 modules transformed).
